name: B10-0103/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Türkiye to release and give back their jobs to elected mayors who were removed and jailed. It says these mayors, mostly from opposition parties, were replaced by government appointees on terrorism charges the Parliament calls bogus. The Parliament also asks the European Union to pressure Türkiye, tie financial aid to respect for the rule of law, and consider sanctions against Turkish officials responsible. This is an opinion; the Parliament cannot itself change Turkish law.

- Nothing changes in law yet; the Parliament only calls on Türkiye and the European Union to act.
- It affects dismissed mayors and the voters who elected them, mostly in Kurdish areas.
- Next, the European Union and member states are asked to raise this with Türkiye and consider sanctions.
